ordering_strategy: dependency-first — MEDIUM quick wins that unblock CRITICAL items come first
delegation_policy: Backend tasks → RTX 5090 (Qwen3-Coder-30B) via FTAL harness. Frontend → Expert AI. Each task has user gate.

user_gate_protocol.description: After each task completes, present honest assessment with blocking CLI prompt
user_gate_protocol.format: Assessment block with: what worked, what's partial, known limitations, then prompt for choice

tasks.title: Wire Resume Tailor agent routes + frontend
tasks.description: Resume Tailor agent exists (resume_tailor.py, 187 lines) but API routes in agents_routes.py aren't connected. ResumeTailor.jsx frontend exists but calls dead endpoints.
bugs_found: BUG: resume_tailor.py called get_deep_profiler() — function doesn't exist. Fixed to get_deep_profile_engine() + get_profile_with_meta()
BUG: resume_tailor.py used job_keywords as resume skills (line 64) — should extract from resume text. Fixed: extract_keywords(resume_text) for resume, extract_skill_phrases(jd_text) for JD
tasks.finding: Routes were ALREADY wired in agents_routes.py (POST+GET /api/agents/tailor/<posting_id>). Frontend ResumeTailor.jsx was ALREADY rendering in AgentDashboard. The real issue was 2 bugs in resume_tailor.py that would cause runtime failures.

tasks.title: Orchestrated apply workflow: Scout → Tailor → Cover Letter → Track
tasks.description: No end-to-end pipeline connecting job discovery to application. User must manually navigate between Scout, Tailor, Cover Letter, and Pipeline tabs. orchestrator.py (174 lines) exists but is incomplete.

tasks.title: Interview Coach linked from pipeline stage transitions
tasks.description: When posting moves to phone_screen/technical/onsite stage in pipeline, no 'Prepare for Interview' button. interview_coach.start_session() accepts posting_id; needs UI wiring.

tasks.title: Cover Letter generation prompt on pipeline 'applied' transition
tasks.description: When moving posting to 'applied' status, no prompt to generate cover letter. cover_letter.generate() exists; needs pipeline stage transition hook.

tasks.title: Feedback loop: application outcomes → optimization scoring
tasks.description: application_feedback table stores outcomes (rejected/interview/offer) but data is NOT fed back into resume optimization, skills gap, or interview prep. 'Rejected 5x for Kubernetes roles' insight is lost.

tasks.title: Cross-posting JD analysis: skill demand patterns
tasks.description: System stores JDs per posting but doesn't analyze patterns across postings. Can't answer 'what skills appear in 80% of my target jobs?' Needs aggregation of job_postings.description via NLP.

tasks.title: Experience extraction → Resume Builder auto-populate
tasks.description: Experience extraction creates resume_versions as text blobs but doesn't feed structured data (title, employer, bullets) into the builder's section model. User does the work twice.

tasks.title: Salary intelligence: surface compensation data in pipeline + negotiation
tasks.description: Career Advisor has placeholder salary_benchmark(). job_postings stores salary_min/max but not surfaced. Salary negotiation is highest-ROI activity in job search.

tasks.title: Deep Profile feeds into Job Scout scoring
tasks.description: Job Scout scoring uses NLP + LLM but ignores deep profile's higher-order skills, career phases, differentiators. A job requiring 'design thinking' scores low even though deep profile identified it.
bugs_found: BUG: base_agent.py _get_user_profile() called get_deep_profiler() / get_cached_profile() — neither exists. Fixed to get_deep_profile_engine() + get_profile(). Also added higher_order_skills extraction.
BUG: Deep profile technology_mastery could be list or dict — added type handling for both

tasks.title: Follow-up reminder notifications (browser + dashboard badge)
tasks.description: Pipeline get_reminders() computes which apps need follow-up but no push notification, email, or dashboard badge. User must manually check. Missing follow-up windows loses opportunities.

tasks.title: Skills interview results feed into optimization scoring
tasks.description: Skills interview (skills_interview.py) validates/confirms skills through conversation. But confirmed skills don't boost ATS optimization score. Wasted user effort.

tasks.title: Cross-session optimization learning
tasks.description: Each optimization is independent. System doesn't learn 'this resume scored 85 for DevOps but 60 for PM' across sessions. job_sessions stores ats_score; needs aggregation + insight surfacing.
tasks.delegation_note: 5090 generated the endpoint function (sessions_insights). Expert fixed: avg_score=0 not None for empty case, added feedback_analyzer cross-reference, fixed role_resumes tracking bug.

tasks.title: Ready-to-apply checklist per posting
tasks.description: When applying, user should see: resume tailored? cover letter generated? interview prep done? LinkedIn updated? All data exists in separate tables; needs aggregation view per posting.
tasks.delegation_note: 5090 generated both the endpoint function and the test class. Expert fixes: actual ATS score from metadata (not hardcoded 85), interview prep detail shows in-progress vs complete.

tasks.title: Campaign post engagement tracking + feedback loop
tasks.description: Posts generated and exported but no way to record which performed well. Engagement data should feed back into future campaign planning and content strategy.
tasks.delegation_note: 5090 generated both endpoint functions and test class. Expert fixes: comments_count column name (avoid SQL keyword), NULL-safe aggregation, top_post query includes id+title, data= → json= in tests, posts_with_engagement is int not list.

tasks.title: Guided new-user onboarding flow
tasks.description: Onboarding.jsx exists as feature walkthrough but not a guided setup flow. New user has no clear path: upload resume → import LinkedIn → build deep profile → start searching. Needs step-by-step wizard.
